verdict.rationale: Bitwarden documents installing and deploying the product on your own Linux server. This is a first-party way to control where vault data physically resides. The pack has no evidence of choosing a hosted cloud region or of formal data-residency guarantees. missing for 10: selectable cloud hosting regions (e.g. US/EU), documented data-residency commitments, independent corroboration of the self-hosting experience.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: This article will walk you through the procedure to install and deploy Bitwarden to your own Linux server.
